name: Simple Face Moisturiser - Simple Kind To Skin Hydrating Light Moisturiser 125ml
description:
Simple Kind To Skin Hydrating Light Moisturiser – 125ml

Keep your skin soft, smooth, and hydrated with the Simple Kind To Skin Hydrating Light Moisturiser. Designed for all skin types, this gentle moisturizer is perfect for everyday use, especially for sensitive skin.

Key Features & Benefits:

Gentle & Kind to Skin: Formulated without harsh chemicals, ideal for sensitive skin.

Lightweight Hydration: Provides long-lasting moisture without feeling greasy or heavy.

Suitable for All Skin Types: Perfect for daily use on any skin type.

Trusted Brand: Made by Simple, a UK-based skincare brand known for its gentle, effective products.

Manufacturer: Simple
Country of Manufacture: UK
Size: 125ml

Enjoy healthy, nourished skin every day with this reliable, lightweight moisturizer.
